subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt, replace, or reject the open fork PR's sidebar image sizing parity fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the source-visible CSS mismatch, but cleanup automation should not close the issue while an open fork PR uses closing syntax and proposes the narrow fix.

options.title: Adopt or replace the parity fix
options.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open while asking the fork PR author for fresh proof and an updated upstream-ready branch.

options.title: Reject this fix shape
options.body: Keep the issue open only if maintainers believe the oversized image symptom needs a different proven root-cause fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the parity fix
recommendation.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the compared sidebar and main-chat image sizing rules and has the clearest history connection to the UI styling decision.
